Recent 2026 seller guidance also distinguishes SDS for chemical products from exemption sheets and separate UN38.3/battery documentation. Conclusion: retain existing-SDS chemical QA and explicitly route battery/non-chemical/manual-review cases away; do not promise approval. Day-3 live-test checkpoint remains unchanged.
